scenarios.preReviewSubject: A Second Conversation, If You Have 15 Minutes
scenarios.preReviewBody:
Hi Rachel,

When we spoke in March, you suggested I track a few brands. I'm following three of them now, and it has become a regular habit rather than a one-time exercise.

I also spent this summer as an intern at Pinecrest Wealth Partners, where I built a screening model for 40 dividend stocks that was used in client portfolio reviews.

Would you have 15 minutes to talk again? I'd like to hear what you make of where I've taken your suggestion, and what you'd look at next.

Whatever day suits your calendar works on my end. Thank you again for the first conversation!

Best,
